title: Story premise EDU112: The Pulley Trades Distance for Force
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (practical mechanisms). Hook: If the pull gets smaller, what must get longer? Takeaway/theme: An ideal pulley arrangement trades force against distance while conserving work.
description: A model lifter wants a smaller idealized input force, but expects a movable-pulley arrangement to reduce effort without increasing rope travel. A force-and-distance ledger shows the tradeoff under explicit frictionless assumptions.
